claims.reason: captureAccountProofContext/accountProofContextIsCurrent bind in-flight writes to generation, mode, account and setupIdentity(config, account), but setupIdentity has no runtime PID/boot instance. Startup can replace/start the runtime while retaining mcpSetupComplete, and App.currentToolProof consumes that flag.

readState deletes missing or malformed setupIdentityHash without clearing mcpSetupComplete; it does not require setupContract or verification metadata, while currentToolProof checks the positive boolean directly.
The production contextChangeQueue onApplied path and DEV direct Bigger Context caller change an input to setupIdentity but do not invalidate MCP proof fields or retire accountProofGeneration.
launcher:zero-risk-pro changes zeroRiskProEnabled, which is hashed by setupIdentity, but only resets catalog/restart state and leaves mcpSetupComplete, setupIdentityHash and proof generation usable.

Startup reuses persisted positive MCP proof without a general setupContract/hash/current account-config comparison; preserveSetup identity checking is limited to the upgrade.updated branch. Existing logout/account/mode/runtime-failure invalidators do not cover this load-time gap.

roots.title: Positive MCP proof is not bound to the current runtime instance
roots.trigger: A verified runtime is replaced or restarted while account and runtime configuration remain unchanged; the persisted mcpSetupComplete flag survives and setupIdentity produces the same hash for the new instance.
roots.fix: Add a boot/supervisor instance identity to the proof record and currentness predicate, or clear the complete MCP proof whenever the managed runtime starts or is replaced and require fresh verification.

roots.title: Persisted MCP proof can survive incomplete schema or startup identity drift
roots.trigger: A version-1 state record has mcpSetupComplete true with missing or malformed setup identity/contract, or a saved proof no longer matches the current account/configuration at startup.
roots.fix: Fail closed during state normalization/startup unless the contract, identity hash, verification metadata, and current account/config identity are valid and matching; otherwise clear every dependent proof field before publishing readiness.

roots.title: Runtime profile mutations leave MCP proof current after its identity inputs change
roots.trigger: Bigger Context or Zero Risk Pro changes successfully after verification; both settings are inputs to setupIdentity, but their production and DEV callers publish the new setting without invalidating MCP proof.
roots.fix: Use the existing account-proof invalidation path after each successful mutation and before publishing the changed runtime state, including both context queue and DEV direct callers.
